HIG-COMPONENTS-PULL-DOWN-BUTTONS-0006.title: Consider a More pull-down button for nonprominent items

statement.en: Consider a More pull-down button for items that don't need prominence.
statement.ja: prominenceが不要なitemにはMore pull-down buttonを検討する。

conditions: Main-interface space is constrained.
Balance the More button's compact size against reduced content predictability and discoverability.
HIG-COMPONENTS-PULL-DOWN-BUTTONS-0006.review_note: Restored the truncated recommendation and recorded both sides of the documented tradeoff.

statement.en: Avoid using pull-down buttons on tvOS or watchOS.
statement.ja: tvOSまたはwatchOSでpull-down buttonを使わない。

conditions: Pull-down buttons have no additional considerations for macOS or visionOS.
HIG-COMPONENTS-PULL-DOWN-BUTTONS-0007.review_note: Recorded the descriptive tvOS and watchOS limitation at AVOID rather than MUST_NOT.

HIG-COMPONENTS-POP-UP-BUTTONS-0008.title: Consider a pop-up button for compact iPadOS list-item options

statement.en: Consider a pop-up button for compact iPadOS list-item options.
statement.ja: compactなiPadOS list-item optionにはpop-up buttonを検討する。

conditions: The list item appears within a popover or modal view.
The option set is fairly small, well defined, and works well in a menu.
Use the pop-up button instead of navigating through a disclosure indicator to a detail view.
HIG-COMPONENTS-POP-UP-BUTTONS-0008.review_note: Restored the complete truncated recommendation and all documented applicability conditions.

statement.en: Avoid using pop-up buttons on tvOS or watchOS.
statement.ja: tvOSまたはwatchOSでpop-up buttonを使わない。

conditions: Pop-up buttons have no additional considerations for iOS, macOS, or visionOS.
HIG-COMPONENTS-POP-UP-BUTTONS-0009.review_note: Recorded the descriptive tvOS and watchOS limitation at AVOID rather than MUST_NOT.

statement.en: Consider the continuous capacity style for a large range.
statement.ja: large rangeにはcontinuous capacity styleを検討する。

conditions: A discrete capacity indicator would make individual segments too small to be useful.
HIG-COMPONENTS-GAUGES-0003.review_note: Preserved Consider and recorded the large-range legibility condition.

statement.en: Consider changing fill color to communicate significant range levels.
statement.ja: significantなrange levelを伝えるためfill colorの変更を検討する。

conditions: Use a whole-indicator color change or a tiered sequence when it fits the app's meaning.
HIG-COMPONENTS-GAUGES-0004.review_note: Preserved optional color changes and both documented presentation approaches.

statement.en: Avoid using gauges on tvOS.
statement.ja: tvOSでgaugeを使わない。

conditions: Gauges have no additional considerations for iOS, iPadOS, visionOS, or watchOS.
HIG-COMPONENTS-GAUGES-0005.review_note: Recorded the descriptive tvOS limitation at AVOID rather than MUST_NOT.

statement.en: Never partially fill a discrete capacity-indicator segment.
statement.ja: discrete capacity-indicator segmentを部分的にfillしない。

conditions: Each segment represents a discrete unit and fills completely to indicate the current value.
HIG-COMPONENTS-GAUGES-0006.review_note: Recovered the platform-specific MUST_NOT from the explicit never-partially invariant.

statement.en: Choose the spatial Persona template that suits the shared activity.
statement.ja: shared activityに適したspatial Persona templateを選ぶ。

conditions: Compare side-by-side, surround, and conversational layouts against content visibility and social interaction needs.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0006.review_note: Recorded the three system templates and the content-versus-interaction choice.

statement.en: Prepare the visionOS app to launch directly into its shared activity.
statement.ja: visionOS appがshared activityへ直接launchできるように準備する。

conditions: The system automatically launches the app when someone shares the activity in FaceTime.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0007.review_note: Recorded the direct-launch expectation separately from window restrictions and prerequisite tasks.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0008.title: Help people enter a visionOS shared activity together

statement.en: Help people enter a visionOS shared activity together.
statement.ja: peopleがvisionOS shared activityへ一緒に入れるよう支援する。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0008.review_note: Kept synchronized entry at SHOULD and split the adjacent non-coercion guidance into its own AVOID rule.

statement.en: Ensure all participants view the same app state.
statement.ja: すべてのparticipantが同じapp stateを表示するようにする。

exceptions: A participant may temporarily leave the shared activity when needed.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0009.review_note: Retained the explicit Make sure shared-state MUST and its temporary-exit exception.

statement.en: Use Spatial Audio to enrich the shared activity.
statement.ja: Spatial Audioでshared activityを豊かにする。

conditions: Use spatial sound when it strengthens the realism of the shared experience.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0010.review_note: Recorded the intended realism benefit without making Spatial Audio universal.

statement.en: Help people keep private and shared content separate.
statement.ja: private contentとshared contentを区別できるようにする。

conditions: Review both system differentiation and app-provided multiwindow sharing cues.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0011.review_note: Recorded the privacy-sensitive separation outcome and split its multiwindow actions.

statement.en: Let people personalize their experience without changing it for others.
statement.ja: 他のparticipantのexperienceを変えずにpersonalizeできるようにする。

conditions: Support adjustments for accessibility or comfort, such as volume or subtitles.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0012.review_note: Recorded independent personalization and its accessibility and comfort purposes.

statement.en: Consider a unique content view for each participant when perspective matters.
statement.ja: perspectiveが重要な場合はparticipantごとのunique content viewを検討する。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0013.review_note: Preserved optional per-person viewing and its perspective-dependent condition.

statement.en: Make exiting and rejoining a shared activity easy.
statement.ja: shared activityからのexitとrejoinを容易にする。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0014.review_note: Kept the general ease guidance at SHOULD and split the explicit rejoin-control requirement.

statement.en: Avoid using SharePlay on watchOS.
statement.ja: watchOSでSharePlayを使わない。

conditions: SharePlay has no additional considerations for iOS, iPadOS, macOS, or tvOS.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0016.review_note: Recorded the descriptive watchOS limitation at AVOID rather than MUST_NOT.

statement.en: Avoid displaying unrelated windows during automatic shared-activity launch.
statement.ja: shared activityのautomatic launch中に無関係なwindowを表示しない。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0017.review_note: Recovered the launch-specific window restriction without raising want-to-avoid wording to MUST_NOT.

statement.en: Present prerequisite input in an autodismissible window.
statement.ja: prerequisite inputをautodismissible windowで提示する。

conditions: People must complete input, such as sign-in, before joining the shared activity.
Dismiss the window as soon as the required input is complete.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0018.review_note: Recovered the conditional MUST from the explicit be-sure directive and its automatic-dismissal outcome.

statement.en: Check whether synchronized immersion would disrupt a participant's current task.
statement.ja: immersionの同期がparticipantのcurrent taskを妨げないか確認する。

conditions: Check before changing the participant's level of immersion.

statement.en: Avoid forcing an immersion change that disrupts a participant's task.
statement.ja: participantのtaskを妨げるimmersion changeを強制しない。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0020.review_note: Split the lead's don't-force clause at AVOID because it does not use Never or must not.

statement.en: Offer a choice when synchronized immersion would disrupt a participant's task.
statement.ja: immersionの同期がtaskを妨げる場合は参加するか選べるようにする。

conditions: Let the participant choose whether to enter the updated experience.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0030.review_note: Recovered participant choice as the non-coercive synchronization path.

statement.en: Integrate new participants without disrupting the shared experience.
statement.ja: shared experienceを妨げずにnew participantを統合する。

conditions: Update shared immersive content to keep participants synchronized.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0021.review_note: Recovered MUST from the explicit need-to-integrate requirement and preserved its non-disruption outcome.

statement.en: Consider accommodating up to five participants in the spatial arrangement.
statement.ja: spatial arrangementで最大5人のparticipantへの対応を検討する。

conditions: Update participant positions as necessary.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0022.review_note: Preserved the source's consider framing for the five-participant arrangement.

statement.en: Prefer natural social solutions to shared-experience confusion or conflict when possible.
statement.ja: 可能な場合はshared experienceのconfusionやconflictにnatural social solutionを優先する。

conditions: Let participants coordinate verbally or with gestures when social interaction can resolve tool use.

statement.en: Consider a simple conflict-resolution rule when simultaneous changes can conflict.
statement.ja: 同時変更がconflictする場合はsimpleなconflict-resolution ruleを検討する。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0024.review_note: Preserved the conditional consider guidance for app-level conflict resolution.

statement.en: Help people choose which app window to share.
statement.ja: shareするapp windowを選べるようにする。

conditions: The app can open multiple windows.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0025.review_note: Recovered the multiwindow sharing-selection task separately from state distinction.

statement.en: Make shared and unshared app windows easy to distinguish.
statement.ja: shared app windowとunshared app windowを区別しやすくする。

conditions: The app can open multiple windows.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0026.review_note: Recovered the privacy-sensitive multiwindow state distinction.

statement.en: Consider letting people move content from a private window to a shared one.
statement.ja: private windowからshared windowへcontentを移動できるようにすることを検討する。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0027.review_note: Preserved the if-possible content-transfer capability as MAY.

statement.en: Keep participant positions and app context synchronized for per-person shared content.
statement.ja: per-person shared contentでもparticipant positionとapp contextを同期し続ける。

conditions: The app provides per-person versions of shared content.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0031.review_note: Recovered the conditional MUST from the explicit be-sure-to-continue directive.

statement.en: Present a control that lets people quickly rejoin after exiting.
statement.ja: exit後にすばやくrejoinできるcontrolを提示する。

conditions: A participant leaves to perform another task or engage with physical surroundings.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0028.review_note: Recovered MUST from the explicit need-to-present requirement and preserved the quick-rejoin outcome.

statement.en: Consider continuing shared content while a participant hides their spatial Persona.
statement.ja: participantがspatial Personaを隠している間もshared contentの継続表示を検討する。

conditions: Ongoing content helps the participant stay informed about the shared experience.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0029.review_note: Preserved the source's might-want optional framing.

statement.en: Determine study eligibility as soon as possible.
statement.ja: study eligibilityを可能な限り早く判定する。

conditions: Complete eligibility before presenting consent when possible.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-RESEARCHKIT-0013.review_note: Recorded the early eligibility check and its relationship to avoiding unnecessary consent steps.

statement.en: Clearly describe the study's subject and purpose.
statement.ja: studyのsubjectとpurposeを明確に説明する。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-RESEARCHKIT-0014.review_note: Recovered both study-description dimensions from the introduction guidance.

statement.en: Let existing participants quickly sign in and resume an in-progress study.
statement.ja: 既存participantがすばやくsign inして進行中のstudyを再開できるようにする。

conditions: The introduction also serves returning participants.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-RESEARCHKIT-0015.review_note: Recovered the returning-participant path separately from first-time introduction content.

statement.en: Present only eligibility requirements necessary for the study.
statement.ja: studyに必要なeligibility requirementだけを提示する。

conditions: Minimize the eligibility information requested from prospective participants.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-RESEARCHKIT-0016.review_note: Recovered the explicit only restriction as a privacy-sensitive data-minimization MUST.

statement.en: Describe eligibility requirements in simple, straightforward language.
statement.ja: eligibility requirementをsimpleでstraightforwardなlanguageで説明する。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-RESEARCHKIT-0017.review_note: Recovered the eligibility-language quality separately from information-entry ease.

statement.en: Make eligibility information easy to enter.
statement.ja: eligibility informationを入力しやすくする。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-RESEARCHKIT-0018.review_note: Recovered the input-effort guidance as a separate eligibility rule.

statement.en: Ensure the app follows applicable App Store consent requirements.
statement.ja: appが該当するApp Store consent requirementに従うようにする。

conditions: Also review applicable legal and ethics-board requirements outside this design-rule set.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-RESEARCHKIT-0019.review_note: Recovered the explicit Make sure compliance directive without treating this informational page as legal advice.

statement.en: Divide a long consent form into digestible sections.
statement.ja: 長いconsent formを理解しやすいsectionに分割する。

conditions: Let each section focus on one aspect of the study.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-RESEARCHKIT-0020.review_note: Recovered the missing Break lead and preserved the one-aspect section context.

statement.en: Use simple language for each high-level consent overview.
statement.ja: 各consent sectionのhigh-level overviewにsimpleなlanguageを使う。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-RESEARCHKIT-0021.review_note: Recovered the overview-language rule within long-form consent guidance.

statement.en: Provide a detailed consent explanation when necessary.
statement.ja: 必要な場合は詳細なconsent explanationを提供する。

conditions: Let participants open the detail from the corresponding overview section.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-RESEARCHKIT-0022.review_note: Preserved the source's if-necessary condition instead of making detailed text universal.

statement.en: Ensure participants can view the entire consent form before agreeing.
statement.ja: participantが同意前にconsent form全体を閲覧できるようにする。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-RESEARCHKIT-0023.review_note: Recovered MUST from the explicit need-to-be-able requirement before agreement.

statement.en: Consider a comprehension quiz when it fits the consent process.
statement.ja: consent processに適する場合はcomprehension quizを検討する。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-RESEARCHKIT-0024.review_note: Preserved the source's if-it-makes-sense condition as optional guidance.

statement.en: Obtain the participant's consent before they join the study.
statement.ja: participantがstudyへ参加する前にconsentを得る。

conditions: Complete the informed-consent flow before study participation.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-RESEARCHKIT-0025.review_note: Classified the unqualified consent directive as a privacy and explicit-user-intent MUST.

statement.en: Consider collecting participant contact information when appropriate.
statement.ja: 適切な場合はparticipant contact informationの収集を検討する。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-RESEARCHKIT-0026.review_note: Split optional contact information from the mandatory consent decision.

statement.en: Obtain permission before accessing a participant's device or data.
statement.ja: participantのdeviceまたはdataへaccessする前にpermissionを得る。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-RESEARCHKIT-0027.review_note: Classified the direct access-permission requirement as a privacy and explicit-user-intent MUST.

statement.en: Clearly explain why the study needs each requested data type.
statement.ja: studyが各requested data typeを必要とする理由を明確に説明する。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-RESEARCHKIT-0028.review_note: Recovered the purpose explanation separately from permission and minimization.

statement.en: Avoid requesting access to data that isn't critical to the study.
statement.ja: studyに不可欠でないdataへのaccess requestを避ける。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-RESEARCHKIT-0029.review_note: Retained AVOID for the direct don't guidance; the source does not use Never or must not.

statement.en: Obtain notification permission when the study requires notifications.
statement.ja: studyでnotificationが必要な場合はnotification permissionを得る。

conditions: The study needs to send notifications to the participant's device.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-RESEARCHKIT-0030.review_note: Retained the conditional permission requirement as an explicit-user-intent MUST.

statement.en: Tell participants the survey question count and estimated duration.
statement.ja: participantにsurveyのquestion countとestimated durationを伝える。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-RESEARCHKIT-0031.review_note: Recovered both expectation-setting values from the survey list.

statement.en: Use standard question text and slightly smaller explanatory text.
statement.ja: questionにはstandard text、explanationには少し小さいtextを使う。

conditions: The survey question needs additional explanation.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-RESEARCHKIT-0032.review_note: Recovered the conditional text hierarchy without treating the relative size as an absolute measurement.

statement.en: Tell participants when a survey is complete.
statement.ja: surveyが完了したことをparticipantに伝える。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-RESEARCHKIT-0033.review_note: Recovered the survey completion state separately from task completion.

statement.en: Explain task timing and circumstance requirements.
statement.ja: taskのtimingとcircumstance requirementを説明する。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-RESEARCHKIT-0034.review_note: Recovered requirements that affect when or under what circumstances a task is performed.

section_path: Managing personal information and providing encouragement

statement.en: Keep profile and progress screens accessible throughout the app.
statement.ja: profileとprogress screenをapp内で常にaccess可能にする。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-RESEARCHKIT-0035.review_note: Preserved the source's ideal framing at SHOULD rather than MUST.

section_path: Managing personal information and providing encouragement

statement.en: Consider providing an easy way to leave a study from the profile.
statement.ja: profileからstudyを離脱できるeasyな方法の提供を検討する。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-RESEARCHKIT-0036.review_note: Kept the profile exit capability optional because the source presents it as something a profile can provide.

section_path: Managing personal information and providing encouragement

statement.en: Consider profile access to the consent document and privacy policy.
statement.ja: profileからconsent documentとprivacy policyへaccessできるようにすることを検討する。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-RESEARCHKIT-0037.review_note: Kept document access optional because the source presents it as a profile capability.

statement.en: Avoid using ResearchKit on macOS, tvOS, visionOS, or watchOS.
statement.ja: macOS、tvOS、visionOS、watchOSでResearchKitを使わない。

conditions: ResearchKit is supported on iOS and iPadOS.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-RESEARCHKIT-0038.review_note: Recorded the descriptive platform limitation at AVOID rather than MUST_NOT.

statement.en: Show the smallest watchOS map region that encompasses the points of interest.
statement.ja: point of interestを包含する最小のwatchOS map regionを表示する。

conditions: The watchOS map is a noninteractive static snapshot.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAPS-0016.review_note: Recorded the static-map context and kept the positive region-selection guidance at SHOULD.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAPS-0021.title: Ensure the entire watchOS map fits without scrolling

statement.en: Ensure the entire watchOS map interface element is visible without scrolling.
statement.ja: watchOS map interface element全体をscrollなしで表示する。

conditions: Fit the map interface element to the Apple Watch display.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAPS-0021.review_note: Recovered MUST from the explicit needs-to-be-visible requirement.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAPS-0022.title: Ensure all key watchOS map content remains visible

statement.en: Ensure all key watchOS map content is visible within the displayed region.
statement.ja: watchOS mapの全key contentをdisplayed region内に表示する。

conditions: The map interface element does not scroll.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAPS-0022.review_note: Recovered MUST from the explicit all-key-content must-be-visible clause.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAC-CATALYST-0001.title: Make sure Mac-idiom views and images look good

statement.en: Make sure views and images look good when the app uses the Mac idiom.
statement.ja: Mac idiomを使うappでviewとimageを良好に表示する。

conditions: Review unscaled iPadOS views and image assets at 100% rendering size.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAC-CATALYST-0001.review_note: Retained the explicit Make sure MUST and narrowed it to the Mac-idiom rendering context.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAC-CATALYST-0002.title: Make sure important tab items remain quickly accessible

statement.en: Make sure important iPad tab-bar items remain quickly accessible in the Mac app.
statement.ja: importantなiPad tab-bar itemをMac appでもすぐaccessできるようにする。

conditions: List top-level items in the macOS View menu when replacing the tab bar.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAC-CATALYST-0002.review_note: Retained the Make sure MUST and the explicit View-menu technique.

statement.en: Offer multiple ways to move between pages in the Mac app.
statement.ja: Mac appでpage間を移動する複数の方法を提供する。

conditions: Provide Next and Previous buttons for pointer and keyboard users in addition to swipe gestures.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAC-CATALYST-0003.review_note: Recorded the documented controls, modalities, and gesture alternative.

statement.en: Create a macOS version of the app icon for the Mac Catalyst app.
statement.ja: Mac Catalyst app用にmacOS版app iconを作成する。

conditions: Use the lifelike macOS rendering style while maintaining harmony across platforms.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAC-CATALYST-0004.review_note: Recorded both platform-specific rendering and cross-platform continuity.

statement.en: Consider moving controls from the iPad app's main interface to the Mac app toolbar.
statement.ja: iPad appのmain interfaceにあるcontrolをMac app toolbarへ移すことを検討する。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAC-CATALYST-0005.review_note: Preserved Consider and separated the mandatory menu-command follow-up.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAC-CATALYST-0006.title: Use regular size classes in the Mac app

statement.en: Use the regular-width and regular-height size classes in the Mac app.
statement.ja: Mac appでregular-widthとregular-heightのsize classを使う。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAC-CATALYST-0006.review_note: Separated the direct size-class guidance from optional side-by-side reflow.

statement.en: Present Mac inspector UI beside the main content instead of in a popover.
statement.ja: Mac inspector UIをpopoverではなくmain contentの横に表示する。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAC-CATALYST-0007.review_note: Recorded both the placement and the popover alternative.

statement.en: Wherever practicable, adopt a top-down flow in the Mac app.
statement.ja: 可能な限りMac appでtop-down flowを採用する。

conditions: Place the most important actions and content near the top of the window.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAC-CATALYST-0008.review_note: Preserved the practicability qualifier and top-of-window hierarchy.

statement.en: Support both keyboard navigation and keyboard shortcuts in the Mac app.
statement.ja: Mac appでkeyboard navigationとkeyboard shortcutの両方をsupportする。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAC-CATALYST-0009.review_note: Recovered both keyboard expectations from the suitability context.

statement.en: Avoid Mac Catalyst when the essential experience depends on capabilities unavailable on Mac.
statement.ja: essential experienceがMacで利用できないcapabilityに依存する場合はMac Catalystを避ける。

conditions: Examples include device sensors, a rear camera, HealthKit, ARKit, or touch-centric marking, handwriting, and navigation.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAC-CATALYST-0010.review_note: Recorded the suitability boundary and all documented example capability groups.

statement.en: When the iPad idiom already feels at home on Mac, consider switching to the Mac idiom.
statement.ja: iPad idiomがMacになじんだ後はMac idiomへの切替を検討する。

conditions: The Mac idiom can improve detail, Mac-like appearance, performance, and power use.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAC-CATALYST-0011.review_note: Preserved the prerequisite and optional strength plus the documented benefits.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAC-CATALYST-0012.title: Audit layout when adopting the Mac idiom

statement.en: Thoroughly audit the app layout and plan necessary changes when adopting the Mac idiom.
statement.ja: Mac idiomを採用するときapp layoutを十分に監査し必要な変更を計画する。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAC-CATALYST-0012.review_note: Recovered both the audit and change-planning actions.

statement.en: Consider a separate asset catalog for Mac app assets instead of reusing the iPad catalog.
statement.ja: iPad catalogの再利用ではなくMac app asset用の別asset catalogを検討する。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAC-CATALYST-0013.review_note: Preserved Consider and the non-reuse alternative.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAC-CATALYST-0014.title: Adjust Mac-idiom font sizes as needed

statement.en: Adjust font sizes as needed when the app uses the Mac idiom.
statement.ja: Mac idiomを使う場合は必要に応じてfont sizeを調整する。

conditions: Mac-idiom text renders at 100% and can otherwise appear too large.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAC-CATALYST-0014.review_note: Recorded the 100% rendering context and conditional adjustment.

statement.en: Use text styles wherever possible in the Mac idiom.
statement.ja: Mac idiomでは可能な限りtext styleを使う。

statement.en: Avoid fixed font sizes in the Mac idiom.
statement.ja: Mac idiomでfixed font sizeを避ける。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAC-CATALYST-0016.review_note: Separated the fixed-font avoidance from positive text-style guidance.

statement.en: Avoid fixed view and layout sizes in the Mac idiom.
statement.ja: Mac idiomでfixed view sizeとlayout sizeを避ける。

conditions: Unscaled Mac-idiom interface elements report different metrics.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAC-CATALYST-0017.review_note: Recovered the view and layout dimensions omitted by the adjacent font-only rule.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAC-CATALYST-0018.title: Limit appearance customizations to compatible macOS options

statement.en: Limit appearance customizations to standard macOS options that are the same as or similar to iPadOS options.
statement.ja: appearance customizationをiPadOSと同じか類似するstandard macOS optionに限定する。

conditions: Some iPadOS control customizations are unavailable on macOS.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAC-CATALYST-0018.review_note: Recorded the compatibility boundary and unavailable-customization rationale.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAC-CATALYST-0019.title: Ensure a rich Mac Catalyst experience

statement.en: Ensure a Mac Catalyst app provides a rich Mac experience beyond placing an iPadOS layout in a Mac window.
statement.ja: Mac Catalyst appでiPadOS layoutをMac windowに置くだけではないrichなMac experienceを提供する。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAC-CATALYST-0019.review_note: Recovered MUST from the explicit need-to-ensure directive and retained the essential beyond-layout condition.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAC-CATALYST-0020.title: Understand platform differences before adapting views

statement.en: Become familiar with key iPadOS and macOS differences before adapting specific views and controls.
statement.ja: specificなviewやcontrolを調整する前にiPadOSとmacOSの主な違いを理解する。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAC-CATALYST-0020.review_note: Recorded the ordering constraint before view-level adaptation.

statement.en: When the iPad app uses a tab bar, consider a Mac split view with a sidebar or a segmented control.
statement.ja: iPad appがtab barを使う場合はMacでsidebar付きsplit viewまたはsegmented controlを検討する。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAC-CATALYST-0021.review_note: Preserved the tab-bar condition, both alternatives, and Consider strength.

statement.en: Prefer a Mac split view over a segmented control unless the app uses a flat navigation hierarchy.
statement.ja: appがflat navigation hierarchyを使う場合を除きMacではsegmented controlよりsplit viewを優先する。

exceptions: A segmented control can work well for a flat navigation hierarchy.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAC-CATALYST-0022.review_note: Recorded the general preference and the documented flat-hierarchy exception.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAC-CATALYST-0023.title: Use multiple columns on the wider Mac screen

statement.en: Divide a single iPad content-and-actions column into multiple Mac columns where appropriate.
statement.ja: 必要に応じてiPadのcontent-and-actions 1列をMacでは複数列に分ける。

conditions: Use the wider Mac screen to improve the experience.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAC-CATALYST-0023.review_note: Recovered the omitted column transformation and its wide-screen purpose.

statement.en: As the Mac window resizes, consider reflowing content elements into a side-by-side arrangement.
statement.ja: Mac windowのresizeに応じてcontent elementをside-by-side配置へreflowすることを検討する。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAC-CATALYST-0024.review_note: Split the optional reflow clause from the direct size-class guidance.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAC-CATALYST-0025.title: List toolbar commands in Mac menu-bar menus

statement.en: List every command associated with a moved toolbar control in the Mac app's menu-bar menus.
statement.ja: toolbarへ移したcontrolに関連する全commandをMac appのmenu-bar menuに掲載する。

conditions: An iPad main-interface control moves into the Mac toolbar.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAC-CATALYST-0025.review_note: Recovered the conditional MUST from the explicit Be sure to list directive.

statement.en: Place controls from an iPad toolbar in the Mac version's window toolbar.
statement.ja: iPad toolbarのcontrolをMac版window toolbarに配置する。

conditions: The iPad app already provides the controls in a toolbar.

statement.en: Relocate Mac buttons away from the side and bottom screen edges.
statement.ja: Mac buttonをscreenのside edgeとbottom edgeから移動する。

exceptions: Consider another interface area or the Mac window toolbar.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAC-CATALYST-0027.review_note: Recorded the missing relocation lead, removed iPad reachability assumptions, and preserved both destinations.

statement.en: Provide all Mac app commands in the persistent menu bar.
statement.ja: Mac appの全commandをpersistent menu barに提供する。

conditions: Mac users expect the menu bar to expose the app's commands.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAC-CATALYST-0028.review_note: Recovered the platform convention without raising an expectation statement to MUST.

statement.en: Use UIKeyCommand to support keyboard shortcuts for menu commands.
statement.ja: menu commandのkeyboard shortcutをsupportするためUIKeyCommandを使う。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAC-CATALYST-0029.review_note: Recorded the source's implementation mechanism and purpose.

statement.en: Use UIMenuBuilder and UICommand to add or remove custom Mac app menus and commands.
statement.ja: custom Mac app menuとcommandの追加・削除にUIMenuBuilderとUICommandを使う。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAC-CATALYST-0030.review_note: Recorded both APIs and the add/remove custom-menu scope.

statement.en: Consider additional Mac objects that could support context menus.
statement.ja: context menuをsupportできる追加のMac objectを検討する。

conditions: Existing iPad context menus convert automatically.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAC-CATALYST-0031.review_note: Preserved Consider and separated automatic conversion from new design work.

statement.en: Provide context menus with relevant actions for suitable Mac objects.
statement.ja: 適切なMac objectにrelevant actionを含むcontext menuを提供する。

conditions: Mac users tend to expect object-level context menus.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAC-CATALYST-0032.review_note: Recorded action relevance while avoiding an unconditional every-object rule.

statement.en: Avoid using Mac Catalyst on iOS, tvOS, visionOS, or watchOS.
statement.ja: iOS、tvOS、visionOS、watchOSでMac Catalystを使わない。

conditions: Mac Catalyst applies to iPadOS and macOS with no additional platform considerations.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAC-CATALYST-0033.review_note: Recorded the descriptive platform limitation at AVOID rather than MUST_NOT.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IN-APP-PURCHASE-0030.title: Consider a modal sheet for watchOS subscription details

statement.en: Consider a modal sheet for required watchOS subscription information.
statement.ja: requiredなwatchOS subscription informationの表示にmodal sheetを検討する。

conditions: Present every required item in one scrollable view after people choose to learn more.
Use the default Close button to provide a one-tap return to free content.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IN-APP-PURCHASE-0030.review_note: Preserved Consider and recorded the single-view, scrolling, and default-close behavior.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IN-APP-PURCHASE-0031.title: Make watchOS subscription options easy to compare

statement.en: Make watchOS subscription options easy to compare on the small screen.
statement.ja: smallなwatchOS screenでsubscription optionを比較しやすくする。

conditions: People need to scan multiple choices before selecting one.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IN-APP-PURCHASE-0031.review_note: Recorded the small-screen comparison goal separately from required term comprehension.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IN-APP-PURCHASE-0034.title: Clarify watchOS functionality and content differences

statement.en: Clarify when the watchOS app offers different functionality or a subset of content from other app versions.
statement.ja: watchOS appが他versionと異なるfunctionalityまたはcontent subsetを提供する場合は差異を明確にする。

conditions: The watchOS version differs in functionality or available subscription content.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IN-APP-PURCHASE-0034.review_note: Raised the existing rule to MUST from the conditional Be sure directive and narrowed its scope to actual differences.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IN-APP-PURCHASE-0036.title: Ensure watchOS shows the complete subscription information set

statement.en: Ensure the watchOS sign-up screen shows the same required subscription information as other app versions.
statement.ja: watchOS sign-up screenに他のapp versionと同じrequired subscription informationを表示する。

conditions: Use the complete required-item list documented in Making signup effortless.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IN-APP-PURCHASE-0036.review_note: Recovered MUST from the explicit needs-to requirement and preserved cross-version information parity.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IN-APP-PURCHASE-0037.title: Describe watchOS subscription advantages straightforwardly

statement.en: Describe the advantages of accessing subscription content through watchOS straightforwardly.
statement.ja: watchOSからsubscription contentへaccessする利点を率直に説明する。

conditions: Set accurate expectations about the watchOS experience.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IN-APP-PURCHASE-0037.review_note: Recovered the direct wording guidance separately from the non-equivalence avoidance.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IN-APP-PURCHASE-0038.title: Avoid implying watchOS parity with other app versions

statement.en: Avoid implying that the watchOS subscription experience is identical to other app versions.
statement.ja: watchOS subscription experienceが他のapp versionと同一だと示唆しない。

conditions: The watchOS functionality or content differs from another device version.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IN-APP-PURCHASE-0038.review_note: Separated the explicit expectation-setting avoidance from positive feature descriptions.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IN-APP-PURCHASE-0039.title: Design a complete, efficient custom watchOS signup flow

statement.en: When replacing the modal sheet, design a complete and efficient custom watchOS sign-up flow.
statement.ja: modal sheetを使わない場合はcompleteでefficientなcustom watchOS sign-up flowを設計する。

conditions: The app uses a custom sign-up view instead of the suggested modal sheet.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IN-APP-PURCHASE-0039.review_note: Recovered the custom-view branch and both required flow qualities.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IN-APP-PURCHASE-0040.title: Include an exit in a custom watchOS signup view

statement.en: Include a Close or Cancel button in a custom watchOS sign-up view.
statement.ja: custom watchOS sign-up viewにCloseまたはCancel buttonを含める。

conditions: The button returns people to the app's free content.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IN-APP-PURCHASE-0040.review_note: Recovered the explicit custom-flow exit and its return destination.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IN-APP-PURCHASE-0041.title: Ensure people understand subscription terms before choosing

statement.en: Ensure people understand each watchOS subscription option's terms before choosing one.
statement.ja: watchOS subscription optionを選ぶ前に各optionのtermsを理解できるようにする。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IN-APP-PURCHASE-0041.review_note: Recovered the purchase-decision MUST from the explicit need-to-understand statement.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IN-APP-PURCHASE-0042.title: Show watchOS subscription duration and discounts compactly

statement.en: Display each watchOS subscription option's duration and discount information compactly for easy scanning and comparison.
statement.ja: 各watchOS subscription optionのdurationとdiscount informationをscanとcomparisonがしやすいcompactな形で表示する。

conditions: Multiple options need to fit a small screen.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IN-APP-PURCHASE-0042.review_note: Recovered both required information types and all three presentation qualities.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IN-APP-PURCHASE-0043.title: Consider one button per watchOS payment option

statement.en: Consider displaying each watchOS payment option in a separate button.
statement.ja: 各watchOS payment optionを別々のbuttonで表示することを検討する。

conditions: One button per option lets people start signup with one tap.
Keep each button visually locked to its description, including while scrolling.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IN-APP-PURCHASE-0043.review_note: Preserved the source's optional layout framing and recorded one-tap and scrolling relationships.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IN-APP-PURCHASE-0044.title: Consider watchOS options in list rows above one signup button

statement.en: Consider one watchOS subscription option per list row followed by a signup button.
statement.ja: watchOS subscription optionを1 rowずつ表示し、その後にsignup buttonを置くlayoutを検討する。

conditions: The list minimizes scrolling while keeping choices scannable.
The button title may update to reflect the selected option.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IN-APP-PURCHASE-0044.review_note: Preserved the optional alternative layout and its compactness and selected-option feedback.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IMESSAGE-APPS-AND-STICK.title: Prefer one primary iMessage app experience

statement.en: Prefer providing one primary experience in an iMessage app.
statement.ja: iMessage appでは1つのprimary experienceを提供することを優先する。

conditions: People open the app while already in a conversational flow.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IMESSAGE-APPS-AND-STICK.review_note: Recorded the conversational context and preserved Prefer at SHOULD.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IMESSAGE-APPS-AND-STICK.title: Consider surfacing related app content in iMessage

statement.en: Consider surfacing shareable content or a simple collaborative task from the related iOS or iPadOS app.
statement.ja: 関連するiOSまたはiPadOS appから共有可能なcontentやsimple collaborative taskをiMessageに出すことを検討する。

conditions: The content or task fits naturally into a conversation.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IMESSAGE-APPS-AND-STICK.review_note: Preserved Consider and captured both documented content and collaboration uses.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IMESSAGE-APPS-AND-STICK.title: Create expressive, inclusive, versatile stickers

statement.en: Create stickers that are expressive, inclusive, and versatile.
statement.ja: expressive、inclusive、versatileなstickerを作成する。

conditions: The stickers may be static images or short animations.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IMESSAGE-APPS-AND-STICK.review_note: Retained all three documented sticker-design qualities.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IMESSAGE-APPS-AND-STICK.title: Present essential features in the compact view

statement.en: Present essential iMessage app features in the compact view.
statement.ja: essentialなiMessage app featureをcompact viewに表示する。

conditions: The compact view appears below the message transcript.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IMESSAGE-APPS-AND-STICK.review_note: Recorded the compact-view location and kept essential-feature guidance atomic.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IMESSAGE-APPS-AND-STICK.title: Ensure the primary iMessage experience is immediately understandable

statement.en: Ensure iMessage app functionality or content is easy to understand and immediately available.
statement.ja: iMessage appのfunctionalityまたはcontentを理解しやすく、すぐ利用できるようにする。

conditions: People choose the app while continuing a conversation.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IMESSAGE-APPS-AND-STICK.review_note: Recovered MUST from the explicit needs-to requirement and preserved both usability qualities.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IMESSAGE-APPS-AND-STICK.title: Consider separate apps for distinct iMessage experiences

statement.en: When offering distinct functionality or content collections, consider a separate iMessage app for each one.
statement.ja: 異なるfunctionalityやcontent collectionを提供する場合は、それぞれ別のiMessage appにすることを検討する。

conditions: One primary experience cannot clearly contain the distinct offerings.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IMESSAGE-APPS-AND-STICK.review_note: Preserved the multiple-offering condition and Consider strength.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IMESSAGE-APPS-AND-STICK.title: Make sure frequent items are in the compact view

statement.en: Make sure the most frequently used iMessage app items are available in the compact view.
statement.ja: 最も頻繁に使うiMessage app itemをcompact viewで利用できるようにする。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IMESSAGE-APPS-AND-STICK.review_note: Recovered MUST from the explicit Make sure directive.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IMESSAGE-APPS-AND-STICK.title: Reserve additional content for the expanded view

statement.en: Reserve additional iMessage app content and features for the expanded view.
statement.ja: additionalなiMessage app contentとfeatureはexpanded viewに配置する。

conditions: Keep the compact view focused on essential and frequently used items.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IMESSAGE-APPS-AND-STICK.review_note: Separated the expanded-view allocation from the explicit compact-view MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IMESSAGE-APPS-AND-STICK.title: Keep text editing in the expanded view by default

statement.en: By default, let people edit text only in the expanded iMessage app view.
statement.ja: 通常はexpanded iMessage app viewでだけtextを編集できるようにする。

conditions: The compact view occupies roughly the same space as the keyboard.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IMESSAGE-APPS-AND-STICK.review_note: Preserved the source's In general qualifier as a default rather than an absolute.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IMESSAGE-APPS-AND-STICK.title: Show the keyboard in the expanded view

statement.en: Display the keyboard in the expanded view while people edit iMessage app content.
statement.ja: iMessage app contentの編集中はexpanded viewでkeyboardを表示する。

conditions: Keep the app's content visible while people edit.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IMESSAGE-APPS-AND-STICK.review_note: Recovered the keyboard placement and its content-visibility purpose.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IMESSAGE-APPS-AND-STICK.title: Make sure every sticker remains legible

statement.en: Make sure every sticker remains legible across backgrounds and when rotated or scaled.
statement.ja: すべてのstickerをさまざまなbackgroundやrotation、scaleでもlegibleに保つ。

conditions: Review both static images and short animations.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IMESSAGE-APPS-AND-STICK.review_note: Recovered MUST from the explicit Make sure directive and preserved every documented transformation.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IMESSAGE-APPS-AND-STICK.title: Consider transparency for sticker integration

statement.en: Consider transparency to help a sticker integrate visually with conversation content.
statement.ja: stickerをconversation contentへ視覚的に統合するためtransparencyを検討する。

conditions: Surrounding content can include text, photos, and other stickers.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IMESSAGE-APPS-AND-STICK.review_note: Preserved optionality and all documented surrounding content types.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IMESSAGE-APPS-AND-STICK.title: Provide localized alternative text for every sticker

statement.en: Provide a localized alternative description for every sticker.
statement.ja: すべてのstickerにlocalized alternative descriptionを提供する。

conditions: VoiceOver speaks the description to help people use the sticker pack.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IMESSAGE-APPS-AND-STICK.review_note: Recovered the omitted VoiceOver requirement and applied accessibility priority without raising it to MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IMESSAGE-APPS-AND-STICK.title: Supply a square-cornered icon for each extension

statement.en: Supply a square-cornered icon for each iMessage app or sticker-pack extension.
statement.ja: 各iMessage appまたはsticker-pack extensionにsquare-cornered iconを提供する。

conditions: The system automatically applies the rounded-corner mask.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IMESSAGE-APPS-AND-STICK.review_note: Recorded the per-extension source asset and the system-applied mask.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IMESSAGE-APPS-AND-STICK.title: Use the documented iMessage icon dimensions

statement.en: Create iMessage app and sticker-pack icons at the documented pixel dimensions for each usage and scale.
statement.ja: 各usageとscaleについて記載されたpixel dimensionでiMessage appとsticker-pack iconを作成する。

conditions: For Messages and notifications, use 148×110 and 143×100 at @2x only; use 120×90/180×135, 64×48/96×72, and 54×40/81×60 at @2x/@3x.
For Settings, use 58×58 at @2x and 87×87 at @3x.
For the App Store, use 1024×1024 at both @2x and @3x.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IMESSAGE-APPS-AND-STICK.review_note: Recovered every icon-table row and retained missing @3x values as explicit omissions.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IMESSAGE-APPS-AND-STICK.title: Choose one sticker size for the content

statement.en: Choose the small, regular, or large sticker size that works best for the content.
statement.ja: contentに最適なsmall、regular、largeのsticker sizeを選ぶ。

conditions: Prepare every sticker in the pack at the chosen size.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IMESSAGE-APPS-AND-STICK.review_note: Recorded the three supported choices and the content-fit criterion.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IMESSAGE-APPS-AND-STICK.title: Avoid mixing sticker sizes in one pack

statement.en: Avoid mixing sticker sizes within a single sticker pack.
statement.ja: 1つのsticker pack内でsticker sizeを混在させない。

conditions: Prepare all stickers at the one selected size.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IMESSAGE-APPS-AND-STICK.review_note: Retained direct don't guidance at AVOID under the conservative strength policy.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IMESSAGE-APPS-AND-STICK.title: Use the documented @3x sticker dimensions

statement.en: Create @3x sticker images at 300×300 pixels for small, 408×408 for regular, or 618×618 for large.
statement.ja: @3x sticker imageはsmallを300×300、regularを408×408、largeを618×618 pixelで作成する。

conditions: The system can generate @2x and @1x variants by downscaling at runtime.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IMESSAGE-APPS-AND-STICK.review_note: Recovered every sticker-size table value and the runtime-downscaling behavior.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IMESSAGE-APPS-AND-STICK.title: Keep every sticker file at 500 KB or smaller

statement.en: Keep every sticker file at 500 KB or smaller.
statement.ja: すべてのsticker fileを500 KB以下にする。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IMESSAGE-APPS-AND-STICK.review_note: Recovered the explicit must-based file-size maximum.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IMESSAGE-APPS-AND-STICK.title: Use PNG for transparent static stickers

statement.en: Use PNG for 8-bit transparency without animation.
statement.ja: 8-bit transparencyを使いanimationを使わないstickerにはPNGを使う。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IMESSAGE-APPS-AND-STICK.review_note: Recovered the PNG transparency and animation capabilities from the format table.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IMESSAGE-APPS-AND-STICK.title: Use APNG for transparent animated stickers

statement.en: Use APNG for 8-bit transparency with animation.
statement.ja: 8-bit transparencyとanimationを使うstickerにはAPNGを使う。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IMESSAGE-APPS-AND-STICK.review_note: Recovered the APNG transparency and animation capabilities from the format table.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IMESSAGE-APPS-AND-STICK.title: Use GIF for single-color transparent animation

statement.en: Use GIF for single-color transparency with animation.
statement.ja: single-color transparencyとanimationを使うstickerにはGIFを使う。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IMESSAGE-APPS-AND-STICK.review_note: Recovered the GIF transparency and animation capabilities from the format table.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IMESSAGE-APPS-AND-STICK.title: Use JPEG only without transparency or animation

statement.en: Use JPEG only when neither transparency nor animation is needed.
statement.ja: transparencyもanimationも不要な場合にだけJPEGを使う。

conditions: JPEG supports neither capability in this sticker format table.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IMESSAGE-APPS-AND-STICK.review_note: Recovered both JPEG limitations without strengthening the table guidance.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IMESSAGE-APPS-AND-STICK.title: Avoid iMessage apps and stickers on unsupported platforms

statement.en: Avoid using iMessage apps and stickers on macOS, tvOS, visionOS, or watchOS.
statement.ja: macOS、tvOS、visionOS、watchOSでiMessage appとstickerを使わない。

conditions: The technology is supported on iOS and iPadOS with no additional platform considerations.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IMESSAGE-APPS-AND-STICK.review_note: Recorded the descriptive platform limitation at AVOID rather than promoting it to MUST_NOT.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ID-VERIFIER-0001.title: Use Display Only for visual confirmation without data transfer

statement.en: Use a Display Only request when the requester needs to visually confirm identity without receiving customer data.
statement.ja: requesterがcustomer dataを受け取らずにidentityを目視確認する場合はDisplay Only requestを使う。

conditions: Show identity data and the customer portrait within system-provided UI on the requester’s iPhone.
The customer data remains in the system UI and is not transmitted to the app.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ID-VERIFIER-0001.review_note: Replaced the three-word false-positive statement with the documented visual-confirmation and no-data-transfer context.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ID-VERIFIER-0002.title: Ask only for identity data needed now

statement.en: Request only the identity data needed for the current verification.
statement.ja: current verificationに必要なidentity dataだけを要求する。

conditions: Requesting more data than the current verification needs can reduce trust.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ID-VERIFIER-0002.review_note: Preserved SHOULD strength while applying privacy priority and the current-verification scope.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ID-VERIFIER-0003.title: Provide a button that starts ID verification

statement.en: Provide a button that initiates the ID verification process.
statement.ja: ID verification processを開始するbuttonを提供する。

conditions: Let the person using the verifier app intentionally start the request.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ID-VERIFIER-0003.review_note: Retained the direct button guidance and recorded explicit user initiation.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ID-VERIFIER-0004.title: Let the requester report a Display Only match result

statement.en: In a Display Only request, let the requester report whether the displayed identity matches the customer.
statement.ja: Display Only requestでは、表示されたidentityがcustomerと一致するかrequesterが報告できるようにする。

conditions: The app receives an approved or rejected result after the requester visually compares the portrait.
exceptions: Labels such as Matches Person and Doesn’t Match Person are examples, not required wording.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ID-VERIFIER-0004.review_note: Recorded the feedback outcome without treating the example button labels as mandatory.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ID-VERIFIER-0005.title: Use Data Transfer only for legally required data handling

statement.en: Use a Data Transfer request only when legal verification requires storing or processing identity information.
statement.ja: legal verificationでidentity informationの保存または処理が必要な場合にだけData Transfer requestを使う。

conditions: Both a legal verification requirement and a need to store or process information must apply.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ID-VERIFIER-0005.review_note: Recovered the privacy-sensitive MUST from the explicit only-when restriction and preserved both conjunctive conditions.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ID-VERIFIER-0006.title: Request the required Data Transfer entitlement

statement.en: Request the additional entitlement required to make a Data Transfer request.
statement.ja: Data Transfer requestに必要な追加entitlementを申請する。

conditions: The app makes a Data Transfer request.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ID-VERIFIER-0006.review_note: Recovered MUST from the explicit You must platform requirement.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ID-VERIFIER-0007.title: Use an age threshold for minimum-age verification

statement.en: Use an age-threshold request when verifying that a customer meets a minimum age.
statement.ja: customerがminimum ageを満たすことを確認する場合はage-threshold requestを使う。

conditions: The verification needs only a yes-or-no minimum-age result.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ID-VERIFIER-0007.review_note: Recovered the data-minimizing request type for minimum-age checks.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ID-VERIFIER-0008.title: Avoid precise age data for threshold checks

statement.en: Avoid requesting a customer’s current age or birth date for a minimum-age check.
statement.ja: minimum-age checkでcustomerのcurrent ageまたはbirth dateを要求しない。

conditions: An age-threshold result can complete the verification without precise age data.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ID-VERIFIER-0008.review_note: Separated the explicit data-minimization avoidance from the positive threshold-request guidance.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ID-VERIFIER-0009.title: Register qualifying apps for ID Verifier

statement.en: If the app qualifies, register for ID Verifier through Apple Business Register.
statement.ja: appが対象となる場合はApple Business Registerを通じてID Verifierへ登録する。

conditions: Registration lets the system show the organization’s official name and logo in the verification UI.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ID-VERIFIER-0009.review_note: Preserved the qualification condition instead of treating registration as universal.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ID-VERIFIER-0010.title: Label verification buttons by request purpose

statement.en: Label a simple age-check button Verify Age and a detailed identity-request button Verify Identity.
statement.ja: simple age-check buttonはVerify Age、detailed identity-request buttonはVerify Identityとlabelする。

conditions: Choose the label that matches the scope of the verification request.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ID-VERIFIER-0010.review_note: Recovered both documented labels and their distinct request scopes.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ID-VERIFIER-0011.title: Avoid communication-type symbols in verification buttons

statement.en: Avoid symbols that imply a particular communication type in an ID verification button.
statement.ja: ID verification buttonで特定のcommunication typeを示すsymbolを避ける。

conditions: Examples include NFC and QR-code symbols.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ID-VERIFIER-0011.review_note: Recovered the direct symbol avoidance and retained the examples as nonexhaustive.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ID-VERIFIER-0012.title: Never include the Apple logo in a verification button label

statement.en: Never include the Apple logo in an ID verification button label.
statement.ja: ID verification button labelにApple logoを含めない。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ID-VERIFIER-0012.review_note: Recovered MUST_NOT from the explicit Never prohibition.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ID-VERIFIER-0013.title: Avoid ID Verifier on unsupported Apple platforms

statement.en: Avoid using ID Verifier on iPadOS, macOS, tvOS, visionOS, or watchOS.
statement.ja: iPadOS、macOS、tvOS、visionOS、watchOSでID Verifierを使わない。

conditions: ID Verifier is supported on iOS and has no additional iOS considerations.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ID-VERIFIER-0013.review_note: Recorded the descriptive platform limitation at AVOID rather than strengthening it to MUST_NOT.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ORNAMENTS-0001.title: Consider ornaments for frequently needed controls

statement.en: Consider an ornament for frequently needed controls or information that need a consistent, uncluttered location.
statement.ja: 頻繁に必要なcontrolや情報を一貫した整理された場所に置くためornamentを検討する。

conditions: Keep the ornament close to its window so people know where to find it.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ORNAMENTS-0001.review_note: Repaired the truncated candidate and preserved the consider strength and predictable-location purpose.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ORNAMENTS-0002.title: Keep ornament width within its window

statement.en: Aim to keep a visionOS ornament no wider than its associated window.
statement.ja: visionOS ornamentの幅を関連window以下に保つ。

conditions: Prevent a wide ornament from interfering with tab bars or vertical content beside the window.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ORNAMENTS-0002.review_note: Recorded the same-or-narrower width boundary and side-content interference risk.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ORNAMENTS-0003.title: Consider borderless ornament buttons

statement.en: Consider borderless buttons on a visionOS ornament’s glass background.
statement.ja: visionOS ornamentのglass backgroundではborderless buttonを検討する。

conditions: The glass background provides enough visual definition without a border.
The system supplies the gaze hover effect automatically.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ORNAMENTS-0003.review_note: Preserved MAY and recorded both glass-background and system-hover behavior.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ORNAMENTS-0004.title: Prefer system visionOS toolbars and tab bars

statement.en: Use system-provided visionOS toolbars and tab bars unless a custom component is necessary.
statement.ja: custom componentが必要でない限りsystem-providedのvisionOS toolbarとtab barを使う。

conditions: System toolbars and tab bars already appear as ornaments.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ORNAMENTS-0004.review_note: Recorded automatic ornament presentation and the custom-component exception.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ORNAMENTS-0005.title: Keep visionOS ornaments generally visible

statement.en: Keep a visionOS ornament visible in general.
statement.ja: 通常はvisionOS ornamentを表示したままにする。

conditions: Preserve consistent access to the ornament’s controls.
exceptions: Hide an ornament when people intentionally immerse themselves in window content such as a video or photo.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ORNAMENTS-0005.review_note: Recovered the general visibility rule and retained the content-immersion exception.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ORNAMENTS-0006.title: Balance windows with multiple ornaments

statement.en: Prioritize the window’s overall visual balance when displaying multiple visionOS ornaments.
statement.ja: 複数のvisionOS ornamentを表示する場合はwindow全体のvisual balanceを優先する。

conditions: Prevent elevated actions from distracting from content or increasing visual weight.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ORNAMENTS-0006.review_note: Recovered the multiple-ornament condition and its distraction and complexity risks.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ORNAMENTS-0007.title: Consider limiting ornament count

statement.en: When necessary, consider limiting the total number of visionOS ornaments.
statement.ja: 必要な場合はvisionOS ornamentの総数制限を検討する。

conditions: Multiple ornaments increase visual weight or make the app feel more complicated.
exceptions: Relocate removed ornament elements into the main window when appropriate.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ORNAMENTS-0007.review_note: Recovered the qualified count-limiting option and the relocation fallback.

HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0001.title: Use tables for nonhierarchical data

statement.en: Use a table instead of a macOS outline view when the data isn’t hierarchical.
statement.ja: dataがhierarchicalでない場合はmacOS outline viewではなくtableを使う。

conditions: The presented data has no parent-and-child hierarchy.
HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0001.review_note: Retained the existing ID and narrowed component selection to nonhierarchical data.

HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0002.title: Use descriptive outline-view headings

statement.en: Use descriptive column headings that give people enough context.
statement.ja: 十分なcontextを伝えるdescriptiveなcolumn headingを使う。

conditions: Each heading identifies the content or attribute in its column.
HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0002.review_note: Retained the context purpose while separating heading wording, capitalization, punctuation, and presence.

HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0003.title: Consider sortable column headings

statement.en: Consider letting people sort a macOS outline view by clicking column headings.
statement.ja: column headingをclickしてmacOS outline viewをsortできるようにすることを検討する。

conditions: Sorting by an outline-view attribute would help people inspect the data.
HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0003.review_note: Preserved the optional consider strength and separated behavior after sorting is offered.

HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0004.title: Let people resize outline-view columns

statement.en: Preserve people’s ability to resize columns.
statement.ja: columnをresizeできる状態を維持する。

conditions: Let people reveal data that is wider than its current column.
HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0004.review_note: Retained the exact contextual duplicate and recorded the variable-width purpose.

HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0005.title: Make nested containers easy to expand

statement.en: Make nested outline-view containers easy to expand and collapse.
statement.ja: nested outline-view containerを簡単にexpandおよびcollapseできるようにする。

conditions: Use disclosure triangles to reveal the children of parent containers.
HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0005.review_note: Retained the interaction goal; Finder click and Option-click behavior remains a reviewed example rather than a universal requirement.

HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0006.title: Consider alternating outline-view rows

statement.en: Consider alternating row colors in a multi-column macOS outline view.
statement.ja: multi-column macOS outline viewではrow colorを交互にすることを検討する。

conditions: Alternating colors help people track values across wide rows.
HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0006.review_note: Preserved MAY and the multi-column, wide-view readability context.

HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0007.title: Allow appropriate outline-view editing

statement.en: Let people edit outline-view data when editing makes sense in the app.
statement.ja: appで適切な場合はoutline-view dataを編集できるようにする。

conditions: Keep single-click editing distinguishable from any double-click action.
HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0007.review_note: Retained the product-fit condition and separated the expected single-click interaction.

HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0008.title: Consider centered cell ellipses

statement.en: Consider a centered ellipsis instead of clipping outline-view cell text.
statement.ja: outline-view cell textをclipする代わりにcentered ellipsisを検討する。

conditions: Preserving both the beginning and end makes truncated content more recognizable.
HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0008.review_note: Preserved MAY and the distinctiveness rationale for middle truncation.

HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0009.title: Consider search for lengthy outline views

statement.en: Consider a search field for a lengthy macOS outline view.
statement.ja: lengthyなmacOS outline viewにはsearch fieldを検討する。

conditions: A window whose primary feature is the outline view can place search in its toolbar.
HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0009.review_note: Preserved MAY and the lengthy, primary-feature context.

HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0010.title: Retain outline-view expansion choices

statement.en: Retain people’s outline-view expansion choices between visits.
statement.ja: outline viewの利用間で人が選んだexpansion stateを保持する。

conditions: Store the expansion state and restore it the next time the outline view appears.
HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0010.review_note: Recorded persistence and restoration as the implementation of retained navigation state.

HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0011.title: Keep hierarchy in the first column

statement.en: Expose outline-view hierarchy only in the first column.
statement.ja: outline-view hierarchyはfirst columnだけに表示する。

conditions: Use other columns only for attributes that supplement the primary hierarchical data.
HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0011.review_note: Activated the previously inactive candidate and retained the first-column-only boundary.

HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0012.title: Use concise noun headings

statement.en: Use nouns or short noun phrases for outline-view column headings.
statement.ja: outline-view column headingにはnounまたは短いnoun phraseを使う。

conditions: Keep each heading concise while identifying its column.
HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0012.review_note: Recovered the heading-part-of-speech guidance as a separate atomic rule.

HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0013.title: Capitalize outline-view headings consistently

statement.en: Use title-style capitalization for outline-view column headings.
statement.ja: outline-view column headingにはtitle-style capitalizationを使う。

conditions: Apply the convention to every visible column heading.
HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0013.review_note: Recovered capitalization separately from wording and punctuation.

HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0014.title: Avoid punctuation in outline-view headings

statement.en: Avoid punctuation in outline-view column headings, especially a trailing colon.
statement.ja: outline-view column headingではpunctuation、特にtrailing colonを避ける。

conditions: The text functions as a column heading rather than a sentence.
HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0014.review_note: Recovered the explicit avoid clause conservatively as AVOID, not MUST_NOT.

HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0015.title: Always provide multi-column outline-view headings

statement.en: Always provide column headings in a multi-column macOS outline view.
statement.ja: multi-column macOS outline viewでは常にcolumn headingを提供する。

conditions: The outline view contains more than one column.
HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0015.review_note: Recovered the unqualified Always directive and retained its multi-column scope.

HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0016.title: Provide context when omitting a single heading

statement.en: When a single-column outline view omits its heading, provide a label or another source of sufficient context.
statement.ja: single-column outline viewでheadingを省略する場合はlabelなどで十分なcontextを提供する。

conditions: The outline view has one column and no visible column heading.
HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0016.review_note: Recovered the conditioned fallback without extending it to multi-column views.

HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0017.title: Support both sort directions

statement.en: Support ascending and descending sorts for clickable outline-view column headings.
statement.ja: click可能なoutline-view column headingでascendingとdescendingのsortをsupportする。

conditions: The app offers sorting through column-heading clicks.
HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0017.review_note: Recovered both sort directions as behavior conditioned on offering sortable headings.

HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0018.title: Consider secondary-column sorting

statement.en: When necessary, consider secondary-column sorting behind the scenes.
statement.ja: 必要な場合はsecondary-column sortingを内部で行うことを検討する。

conditions: A primary sort needs a secondary attribute to produce a useful stable order.
HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0018.review_note: Preserved the optional and necessary qualifications.

HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0019.title: Sort primary columns by hierarchy level

statement.en: When people sort by the primary column, sort independently at each hierarchy level.
statement.ja: primary columnでsortする場合は各hierarchy levelを個別にsortする。

conditions: People click the primary hierarchical column heading in a sortable outline view.
HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0019.review_note: Recovered hierarchy-level sorting separately from the optional decision to offer sorting.

HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0020.title: Reverse repeated column sorts

statement.en: Reverse the sort direction when people click the currently sorted column heading.
statement.ja: 現在sort済みのcolumn headingをclickした場合はsort directionを反転する。

conditions: The clicked column is already the active sort column.
HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0020.review_note: Recovered the repeated-click behavior as a conditioned sorting rule.

HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0021.title: Use single-click cell editing

statement.en: Use a single click to edit an editable outline-view cell.
statement.ja: editableなoutline-view cellはsingle clickで編集する。

conditions: The cell supports direct editing.
exceptions: A double click may perform a distinct action, such as opening the represented item.
HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0021.review_note: Recovered the explicit editing expectation and retained the distinct double-click exception.

HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0022.title: Consider useful row changes

statement.en: When useful, consider letting people reorder, add, and remove outline-view rows.
statement.ja: 有用な場合はoutline-view rowのreorder、add、removeを可能にすることを検討する。

conditions: The row operation supports the app’s data-management task.
HIG-COMPONENTS-OUTLINE-VIEWS-0022.review_note: Recovered the qualified row-mutation option without promoting it above MAY.

HIG-COMPONENTS-PATH-CONTROLS-0001.title: Place path controls in the window body

statement.en: Place a macOS path control in the window body, not the window frame.
statement.ja: macOS path controlはwindow frameではなくwindow bodyに配置する。

conditions: Do not place a path control in a toolbar or status bar.
HIG-COMPONENTS-PATH-CONTROLS-0001.review_note: Retained the only explicit directive and recorded the toolbar and status-bar exclusions; style descriptions remain nonnormative context.

HIG-COMPONENTS-PICKERS-0001.title: Consider pickers for medium-to-long lists

statement.en: Consider a picker for a medium-to-long list of distinct choices.
statement.ja: medium-to-longなdistinct choiceのlistにはpickerを検討する。

conditions: A picker helps people scroll efficiently through more choices than a short menu should contain.
HIG-COMPONENTS-PICKERS-0001.review_note: Preserved MAY and separated the short-list and very-large-list alternatives.

HIG-COMPONENTS-PICKERS-0002.title: Order picker values predictably

statement.en: Use predictable, logically ordered picker values.
statement.ja: picker valueをpredictableかつlogicalに並べる。

conditions: Help people infer hidden values and move through them quickly.
Account for system ordering based on device language or location.
HIG-COMPONENTS-PICKERS-0002.review_note: Recorded hidden-value predictability and locale-dependent ordering.

HIG-COMPONENTS-PICKERS-0003.title: Avoid switching views for a picker

statement.en: Avoid switching views solely to show a picker.
statement.ja: pickerを表示するためだけのview切替を避ける。

conditions: Display the picker in context below or near the field people are editing.
A picker commonly appears at the bottom of a window or in a popover.
HIG-COMPONENTS-PICKERS-0003.review_note: Retained AVOID and recorded both contextual placement patterns.

HIG-COMPONENTS-PICKERS-0004.title: Consider coarser minute intervals

statement.en: Consider less granular minute intervals when minute-by-minute date-picker precision is unnecessary.
statement.ja: minute単位のdate-picker precisionが不要な場合は粗いminute intervalを検討する。

conditions: The default minute list contains values from 0 through 59.
If increasing the interval, choose a value that divides evenly into 60.
HIG-COMPONENTS-PICKERS-0004.review_note: Preserved MAY while recording the source-scoped divisor constraint.

HIG-COMPONENTS-PICKERS-0005.title: Use compact date pickers in constrained space

statement.en: Use a compact iOS or iPadOS date picker when space is constrained.
statement.ja: spaceが限られる場合はcompactなiOSまたはiPadOS date pickerを使う。

conditions: The compact button shows the current value and opens a modal calendar and time editor.
Let people make multiple edits before tapping outside the modal view to confirm them.
HIG-COMPONENTS-PICKERS-0005.review_note: Retained the iOS and iPadOS scope and recorded the compact interaction flow.

HIG-COMPONENTS-PICKERS-0006.title: Choose a suitable macOS date-picker style

statement.en: Choose a macOS date-picker style that suits the app’s space and selection task.
statement.ja: appのspaceとselection taskに合うmacOS date-picker styleを選ぶ。

conditions: Use textual style for limited space and specific date or time selections.
Use graphical style for calendar browsing, date ranges, or an appropriate clock-face appearance.
HIG-COMPONENTS-PICKERS-0006.review_note: Retained macOS scope and recorded both textual and graphical style mappings.

HIG-COMPONENTS-PICKERS-0007.title: Consider pull-down buttons for short lists

statement.en: For a fairly short choice list, consider a pull-down button instead of a picker.
statement.ja: fairly shortなchoice listにはpickerではなくpull-down buttonを検討する。

conditions: A picker would add too much visual weight for the small number of choices.
HIG-COMPONENTS-PICKERS-0007.review_note: Recovered the short-list alternative without promoting its consider strength.

HIG-COMPONENTS-PICKERS-0008.title: Consider lists or tables for very large sets

statement.en: For a very large item set, consider a list or table instead of a picker.
statement.ja: very largeなitem setにはpickerではなくlistまたはtableを検討する。

conditions: Adjustable height or a table index would make a large set faster to navigate.
HIG-COMPONENTS-PICKERS-0008.review_note: Recovered the very-large-set alternative and its navigation rationale.

HIG-COMPONENTS-PICKERS-0009.title: Keep countdown date pickers within supported limits

statement.en: Keep iOS and iPadOS countdown-timer picker values at or below 23 hours and 59 minutes.
statement.ja: iOSおよびiPadOSのcountdown-timer picker valueを23時間59分以下に保つ。

conditions: Use a wheels style because countdown-timer mode is unavailable in inline and compact styles.
HIG-COMPONENTS-PICKERS-0009.review_note: Repaired the truncated mode description and recorded both its maximum value and unavailable styles without inventing a MUST.

HIG-COMPONENTS-RATING-INDICATORS-0001.title: Let people change rankings inline

statement.en: Let people change an individual item’s ranking inline without opening a separate editing screen.
statement.ja: separate editing screenを開かずに個別itemのrankingをinlineで変更できるようにする。

conditions: The interface presents a list of ranked items.
HIG-COMPONENTS-RATING-INDICATORS-0001.review_note: Replaced the vague generated wording with the source-supported inline editing behavior.

HIG-COMPONENTS-RATING-INDICATORS-0002.title: Make custom rating symbols clear

statement.en: Make sure the purpose of a custom macOS rating symbol is clear.
statement.ja: custom macOS rating symbolのpurposeを明確にする。

conditions: The app replaces the recognizable default star with a custom symbol.
HIG-COMPONENTS-RATING-INDICATORS-0002.review_note: Recovered the conditional Make sure directive and retained its custom-symbol scope.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SEARCH-FIELDS-0001.title: Use helpful search placeholders

statement.en: Use placeholder text when it clarifies what people can search for.
statement.ja: 何を検索できるか明確になる場合はplaceholder textを使う。

conditions: Reinforce the search scope or explain the type of content available to search.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SEARCH-FIELDS-0001.review_note: Narrowed placeholder use to the source-supported education and scope purposes.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SEARCH-FIELDS-0002.title: Consider suggested search terms

statement.en: Consider showing suggested search terms.
statement.ja: suggested search termの表示を検討する。

conditions: Suggestions may include recent searches before input or predictions as people type.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SEARCH-FIELDS-0002.review_note: Preserved MAY and both timing patterns for suggestions.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SEARCH-FIELDS-0003.title: Prioritize relevant search results

statement.en: Present the most relevant search results first.
statement.ja: 最もrelevantなsearch resultを先に表示する。

conditions: Minimize the scrolling people need to find likely results.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SEARCH-FIELDS-0003.review_note: Made the vague simplify lead concrete and separated optional categorization.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SEARCH-FIELDS-0004.title: Consider search-result filters

statement.en: Consider letting people filter search results.
statement.ja: search resultをfilterできるようにすることを検討する。

conditions: A scope bar in the results area can provide quick filtering.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SEARCH-FIELDS-0004.review_note: Preserved MAY and recorded the source filtering mechanism.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SEARCH-FIELDS-0005.title: Use scope bars for defined categories

statement.en: Use a scope bar to filter among clearly defined search categories.
statement.ja: 明確に定義されたsearch categoryのfilterにはscope barを使う。

conditions: Let people move from a broad scope to a narrower one.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SEARCH-FIELDS-0005.review_note: Recorded category clarity and broad-to-narrow refinement.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SEARCH-FIELDS-0006.title: Use tokens for common filters

statement.en: Use tokens to filter by common search terms or items.
statement.ja: common search termやitemによるfilterにはtokenを使う。

conditions: Represent each token as one selectable and editable item that clarifies or focuses the query.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SEARCH-FIELDS-0006.review_note: Recorded the common-filter purpose and single-item editing behavior.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SEARCH-FIELDS-0007.title: Consider pairing tokens with suggestions

statement.en: Consider pairing search tokens with suggestions.
statement.ja: search tokenとsuggestionの組み合わせを検討する。

conditions: Suggestions help people discover which tokens are available.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SEARCH-FIELDS-0007.review_note: Preserved MAY and the token-discovery purpose.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SEARCH-FIELDS-0008.title: Choose standard iOS search tabs for discovery

statement.en: Choose the standard iOS search-tab style for suggestions, discovery, and exploration.
statement.ja: suggestion、discovery、explorationにはstandard iOS search-tab styleを選ぶ。

conditions: Use a dedicated landing page to reveal useful content before people begin typing.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SEARCH-FIELDS-0008.review_note: Recorded the standard-tab purpose and landing-page behavior.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SEARCH-FIELDS-0009.title: Choose button-style iOS search for speed

statement.en: Choose the iOS search-tab button appearance for quick, transient search.
statement.ja: quickでtransientなsearchにはiOS search-tab button appearanceを選ぶ。

conditions: Focus the search field and show the keyboard immediately, then return people to the previous tab after search.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SEARCH-FIELDS-0009.review_note: Recorded immediate entry, transient behavior, and return context.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SEARCH-FIELDS-0010.title: Place priority search at the bottom

statement.en: Place iOS search at the bottom when there is room.
statement.ja: spaceがある場合はiOS searchをbottomに置く。

conditions: Search is a priority and should remain easy to reach.
Use an existing toolbar or a search-only toolbar.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SEARCH-FIELDS-0010.review_note: Recorded the space and priority conditions and both toolbar arrangements.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SEARCH-FIELDS-0011.title: Place iOS search at the top when needed

statement.en: Place iOS search at the top when bottom content needs priority or no bottom toolbar exists.
statement.ja: bottom contentを優先する場合、またはbottom toolbarがない場合はiOS searchをtopに置く。

conditions: Bottom search would cover content that supports a primary app function.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SEARCH-FIELDS-0011.review_note: Repaired the truncated candidate and retained both source conditions.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SEARCH-FIELDS-0012.title: Use inline iOS search for local scope

statement.en: Place iOS search inline when proximity strengthens its relationship to the content it searches.
statement.ja: contentとのproximityでsearch scopeが明確になる場合はiOS searchをinlineに置く。

conditions: Search or filtering applies to one view rather than globally, or location is critical to scope.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SEARCH-FIELDS-0012.review_note: Recorded local scope, multiple-search, and content-proximity conditions.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SEARCH-FIELDS-0013.title: Put sidebar filters at the top

statement.en: Put search at the top of an iPadOS or macOS sidebar when it filters content or navigation there.
statement.ja: iPadOSまたはmacOS sidebar内のcontentやnavigationをfilterする場合はsearchをtopに置く。

conditions: Keep a clear separation between the filtered sidebar and an adjacent rich detail view.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SEARCH-FIELDS-0013.review_note: Recorded sidebar-filter scope and adjacent-view separation.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SEARCH-FIELDS-0014.title: Use dedicated search areas for discovery

statement.en: Include search as an iPadOS or macOS sidebar or tab-bar item when discovery needs a dedicated area.
